limitations: A failing or incomplete attempt does not qualify a target; failures and missing reports remain explicit.
All absolute and growth caps retain their preexisting values; the added64MiB late-median and5s observation-gap budgets were declared before measurement.
The separate53-case functional suite is not run by this selected performance-only configuration.
Even a passing15minute disposable Linux run does not satisfy the required eight-hour installed working-day soak, full ten-target native matrix, vendor traffic or any whole readiness gate.
BSD public-source mapping was approved and the corrected four-target core fixture qualified separately; it does not qualify an installed desktop target.
Mac launch diagnostics remain held. Private-output architecture selection and public signing identities remain unresolved. No new approval is inferred from unrelated grants.
Read-only visibility/focus snapshots and whole private-job startup CPU do not isolate exact readiness-to-frame CPU or prove a particular rendering or scheduler cause.
A single editor-guidance candidate cohort does not establish repeat memory or latency reliability; normal geometry/color acceptance and installed qualification remain separate.
